name: Tankle Adventure
author: Milky Natas
description: A top-down tank adventure through forests and mountains: blast the enemy tanks and turrets in your way. Z to fire, X to dash if you have Nitro.

descriptions.en: A top-down tank adventure through forests and mountains: blast the enemy tanks and turrets in your way. Z to fire, X to dash if you have Nitro.
descriptions.it: Avventura con un carro armato vista dall'alto tra foreste e montagne: distruggi carri e torrette nemiche sul tuo cammino. Z per sparare, X per lo scatto se hai il Nitro.
